        ,idno as cust_id

              when FHID not in ('PS','CB','YB','SN') then '基金' 
              when TRIM(FHID) ='YB' then 'ETF'
              when FHID ='PS' then '海外股票'
              when FHID like 'TA%' or FHID  like 'TB%' or FHID  like 'TD%' or FHID  like 'TE%'  then '集合管理帳戶'

group by  
      to_char(to_date(feedate+19110000,'yyyymmdd') ,'yyyymmdd' )   --substr(FEEDATE,1,6),
      ,idno
      ,case 
              when FHID not in ('PS','CB','YB','SN') then '基金' 
              when TRIM(FHID) ='YB' then 'ETF'
              when FHID ='PS' then '海外股票'
              when FHID like 'TA%' or FHID  like 'TB%' or FHID  like 'TD%' or FHID  like 'TE%'  then '集合管理帳戶'

properties.sourceSql:
/*
Author : 1121329
create date :20250626
memo : 
     ROA :  總收入/AUM
     ROBA : 放款客戶總收入/LUM
*/


drop table ROA_TMP_01;
create table ROA_TMP_01
as 
select a.*,b.amt as INCOME,
       c.AUM as AUM ,
       d.ln_amt 
from PB_CUST_TMP06 a  --客戶  28470
left join  ( select cust_id,substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,sum(amt) amt from INCOME_TMP02 group by cust_id,substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) ) b  --收入 28470
on a.yyyymm=b.yyyymm and a.cust_id=b.cust_id
left join (select substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,cust_id,sum(amt) AUM from AUM_TMP02 group by cust_id,substr(yyyymmdd,1,6)) c --AUM  --28470
on a.yyyymm=c.yyyymm and a.cust_id=c.cust_id
left join 
        ( 
         select yyyymm,cust_id,sum(ln_amt) ln_amt
         from 
         (
           SELECT yyyymm,cust_id,ln_bal ln_amt  FROM 台幣放款_私銀
           UNION 
           SELECT yyyymm,cust_id,bal_amt ln_amt  FROM 外幣放款_私銀
           UNION
           SELECT to_number(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1, 'YYYYMM')) YYYYMM,cust_id,ln_bal ln_amt  FROM 台幣放款_私銀CURRENT
           UNION 
           SELECT to_number(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1, 'YYYYMM')) YYYYMM, CUST_ID,bal_amt ln_amt FROM 外幣放款_私銀CURRENT
          ) a
         group by yyyymm,cust_id
          ) d
  on a.yyyymm=d.yyyymm and a.cust_id=d.cust_id;
  
  

drop table ROA_TMP;
create table ROA_TMP
as 
select yyyymm,sht_sub_nm,loan_flg,quota_flg,sum(income) income,sum(aum) aum,sum(ln_amt) ln_amt
from ROA_TMP_01
group by yyyymm,sht_sub_nm,loan_flg,quota_flg;

EXIT;

properties.incomeFilter: 手收／銀行／外國債券_自營
properties.name: 海外債券（自營）
properties.definition: AUM海外債券自營與Income外國債券自營的對應為推論；Income保留ABS規則。

properties.incomeFilter: 手收／銀行／海外債券_信託
properties.name: 海外債券（信託）
properties.definition: 信託持有市值與信託收入來源共用概念。

properties.name: 集合管理帳戶
properties.definition: Income CASE先將TA/TB/TD/TE歸為基金，集合分類不可達；Income連線表示定義待確認，不表示獨立收入已計入。

properties.name: 銀行ETF
properties.definition: 由AUM銀行信託產品分類拆出；Income以FH_TYP ETF分類。

properties.name: 銀行基金
properties.definition: 由AUM銀行信託產品分類拆出；Income以FH_TYP基金分類。

properties.incomeAmountBasis: COMM_AMT 或 PS（metadata 定義為客戶貢獻度）
properties.name: 銀行保險
properties.definition: AUM衡量原始投資金額；Income保留028、029、030三條来源。日檔及月檔重疊尚未證實，概念共用不代表可消除重複計入。

properties.name: 銀行海外股票
properties.definition: 保留銀行通路，與證券複委託股票分開。

properties.name: 規劃型信託
properties.definition: Income舊分類含保管；此共用概念只連046、047，保管048另立概念。

properties.name: 銀行境外結構型商品
properties.definition: 境內結構型、DCI及結構型存款均不併入此概念。

properties.name: 信託保管
properties.definition: 按DSPMS.PB_PMS_AUM的AUM與FEE拆出；Income的SUB_TYPE仍保留現行規劃型信託分類。

properties.name: 存款
properties.definition: AUM保留台幣、外幣、結構型子分類；Income僅映射到存款總類。月更新SQL含台幣、外幣及員工台幣存款，未依產品代碼拆分；不可把總利收重複分配到各子類。

properties.name: 證券複委託債券
properties.definition: 證券通路：部位估值與交易手續費共用概念。

properties.name: 證券複委託外國股票
properties.definition: Income為CFEE減ABFEE乘匯率，保留可能負值。
properties.aumFilter: PROD='外國股票' AND COMP='證券'

properties.name: 證券複委託基金
properties.definition: 與銀行基金分開，保留證券持有及交易費來源。

properties.name: 證券複委託結構型商品
properties.definition: AUM以BOND的TSSN前綴區分，Income以FLG分類。

/*
Author : 1121329
create date :20250626
memo : AUM細項指標
*/
/*  
--9.8.7.5.實際: 存款 AUM總量
--歷史存款資料執行較久，將歷史資料一次性CREATE 後(執行時間為2025/5)，後續再與現況UNION，可減少重新執行時間，
drop table AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP01;
create table AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP01
as  
    SELECT  cust_id,LST_MTN_DT,'存款' as TYP,'台幣' AS TYP_DTL,
            case 
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2311','2321','2322','2331','2332','2333','2335','2336') then '台幣存款'
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'
             end as DETAIL,
             TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, sum(BAL_AMT) as 存款AUM 
    FROM DSDEP.DEP_NT_ACCT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01
    WHERE  TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) IN ('2E3000', '2E3200', '2E3300', '2E3400')   
        AND LST_MTN_DT>='20231201'
    group by cust_id,LST_MTN_DT,TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD), ACT_CD,
          case 
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2311','2321','2322','2331','2332','2333','2335','2336') then '台幣存款'
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'
             end;

drop table AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP02;
create table AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP02
as              
    SELECT  cust_Id,LST_MTN_DT,'存款' as TYP,'台幣' AS TYP_DTL, 
            case 
              when trim(ACC_CD) IN ('2317','2327') then '外幣存款'
              when trim(ACC_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'
             end as DETAIL,
            TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACC_CD, sum(AVAIL_BAL) as 存款AUM --  '台幣'  AS TYP,TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, AVAIL_BAL, GROSS_INCM 
    FROM DSDEP.DEP_FN_ACCT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01
    WHERE TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) IN ('2E3000', '2E3200', '2E3300', '2E3400')   AND LST_MTN_DT>='20231201'
    group by cust_id,lst_MTN_DT,TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD), ACC_CD,
          case 
              when trim(ACC_CD) IN ('2317','2327') then '外幣存款'
              when trim(ACC_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'
             end ;
             
drop table AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP03;
create table AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP03
as     
    SELECT cust_Id,LST_MTN_DT,'存款' as TYP,'外幣' AS TYP_DTL,
            case 
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2311','2321','2322','2331','2332','2333','2335','2336') then '台幣存款'
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'
             end as DETAIL,
             TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, sum(BAL_AMT) as 存款AUM --, GROSS_INCM 
    FROM DSDEP.EMP_DEP_NT_ACCT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01
    WHERE  TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) IN ('2E3000', '2E3200', '2E3300', '2E3400') AND LST_MTN_DT>='20231201'
    group by cust_Id,LST_MTN_DT,TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD), ACT_CD
;
*/
--current
drop table AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP04;
create table AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP04
as  
    SELECT  cust_id,DATA_DT,'存款' as TYP,'台幣' AS TYP_DTL,
             case 
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2311','2321','2322','2331','2332','2333','2335','2336') then '台幣存款'
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'
             end as DETAIL,
            TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, sum(BAL_AMT) as AMT 
    FROM DSDEP.DEP_NT_ACCT@anadbp01_dwdbp01 
    group by cust_id,DATA_DT,TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD), ACT_CD,

 select a.*,b.*,

 (

     ROA :  總收入/AUM
     ROBA : 放款客戶總收入/LUM
*/


drop table ROA_TMP_01;
create table ROA_TMP_01
as 
select a.*,b.amt as INCOME,
       c.AUM as AUM ,
       d.ln_amt 
from PB_CUST_TMP06 a  --客戶  28470
left join  ( select cust_id,substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,sum(amt) amt from INCOME_TMP02 group by cust_id,substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) ) b  --收入 28470
on a.yyyymm=b.yyyymm and a.cust_id=b.cust_id
left join (select substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,cust_id,sum(amt) AUM from AUM_TMP02 group by cust_id,substr(yyyymmdd,1,6)) c --AUM  --28470
on a.yyyymm=c.yyyymm and a.cust_id=c.cust_id
left join 
        ( 
         select yyyymm,cust_id,sum(ln_amt) ln_amt
         from 
         (
           SELECT yyyymm,cust_id,ln_bal ln_amt  FROM 台幣放款_私銀
           UNION 
           SELECT yyyymm,cust_id,bal_amt ln_amt  FROM 外幣放款_私銀
           UNION
           SELECT to_number(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1, 'YYYYMM')) YYYYMM,cust_id,ln_bal ln_amt  FROM 台幣放款_私銀CURRENT
           UNION 
           SELECT to_number(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1, 'YYYYMM')) YYYYMM, CUST_ID,bal_amt ln_amt FROM 外幣放款_私銀CURRENT
          ) a
         group by yyyymm,cust_id
          ) d
  on a.yyyymm=d.yyyymm and a.cust_id=d.cust_id;

from ROA_TMP_01
group by yyyymm,sht_sub_nm,loan_flg,quota_flg;

EXIT;

drop table AUM;

as

    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型

union

    '投資'  TYP,

    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012

    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,

from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018

    '規劃型信託' PROD,

       COMP,
       PROD,
       prft_cntr_cd,
       sht_nm,
       sht_easy_nm,
       sht_sub_nm;

EXIT;

--28.銀行保險手收(日更新)  --COMM_AMT 僅有2025/5月Current檔案
--from dxdmb.aum_acct_ft@anadbp01_dwdbp01 
--select * from DSINS.INSU_RPT_Q01@anadbp01_dwdbp01 
drop table INCOME_028;
create table INCOME_028
as 
select dept_easy_nm,dept_easy_nm2,applicant_id as cust_id,apply_dt as yyyymmdd,sum(COMM_AMT) AMT--dept_easy_nm,dept_easy_nm2,
from DSINS.INSU_RPT_Q01@anadbp01_dwdbp01
group by dept_easy_nm,dept_easy_nm2,applicant_id,apply_dt;
--29.【銀行】保險手收 總量(月更新) --取值PS  
--20251124 調整抓取LST_MTN_DT的下一個月為收入
drop table INCOME_029;
create table INCOME_029
as 
select  cust_id ,
        to_char(add_months(to_date(lst_mtn_dt,'yyyymmdd'),1),'yyyymmdd')as  yyyymmdd,
        sum(ps) amt --,* --lst_mtn_dt,category,sum(ps) --AO_ID,CUST_ID,PS
from DSKPI.KPI_DET_IU_002_NEW@anadbp01_dwdbp01
where ps is not null
group by cust_id ,lst_mtn_dt; 

--where insure_START_DATE = '01140221'
--30.【銀行】保險手收 總量(月更新)   --取值PS
--20251124 調整抓取LST_MTN_DT的下一個月為收入
drop table INCOME_030;
create table INCOME_030
as 
select cust_id ,to_char(add_months(to_date(lst_mtn_dt,'yyyymmdd'),1),'yyyymmdd') as yyyymmdd,sum(ps) amt  -- source_name,lst_mtn_dt,sum(ps) ps,count(*) 人數 --distinct lst_mtn_dt 
from DSKPI.KPI_DET_OFI_001@anadbp01_dwdbp01
where open_account='Y'
group by cust_id ,lst_mtn_dt;
--31.【銀行】海外債券手收 總量

drop table INCOME_031;
create table INCOME_031
as 
select baopcccode as PCCODE,
       idno as cust_id ,
       to_char(to_date(feedate+19110000,'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymmdd') as yyyymmdd, 
       sum(BRHREBATEAMT+(WKR028/100)) amt--baopcccode,sum(BRHREBATEAMT+(WKR028/100)) --feedate,sum(BRHREBATEAMT+(WKR028/100))
from DSFND.PB_FUND_SPREAD_DAILY@anadbp01_dwdbp01
where FHID='CB' --and substr(feedate,1,6)='011403'--01121227    
and baopcccode like '%2E%'    --私銀處
group by baopcccode,idno,feedate;

--and BRHREBATEAMT+(WKR028/100)=416
--32.【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量  -- INC_AMT_NT
drop table INCOME_032;
create table INCOME_032
as 
select cif_id as cust_id ,txn_dt as yyyymmdd,PCC_CODE pccode,sum(ABS(INC_AMT_NT)) amt
from DSWTR.BOND_TXN@anadbp01_dwdbp01
WHERE pcc_code LIKE '2E%'
group by cif_id,txn_dt,PCC_CODE;
--33.34.35.36【銀行】基金手收 總量
--20251124 調整新增判斷saopcccode like '2E%'
drop table INCOME_033_034_035_036;
create table INCOME_033_034_035_036
as 
select  to_char(to_date(feedate+19110000,'yyyymmdd') ,'yyyymmdd' ) as yyyymmdd --substr(FEEDATE,1,6)  -- FHID,IDNO as cust_id,      
        ,idno as cust_id       
        ,case 
              when FHID not in ('PS','CB','YB','SN') then '基金' 
              when TRIM(FHID) ='YB' then 'ETF'
              when FHID ='PS' then '海外股票'
              when FHID like 'TA%' or FHID  like 'TB%' or FHID  like 'TD%' or FHID  like 'TE%'  then '集合管理帳戶'
        end as   FH_TYP 
        ,baopcccode PCCODE
        ,sum(BrhRebateAmt) as AMT
from DSFND.PB_FUND_SPREAD_DAILY@anadbp01_dwdbp01 
where  (baopcccode like '2E%' or saopcccode like '2E%') and feedate>='011212'  --and feedate='011403' 
group by  
      to_char(to_date(feedate+19110000,'yyyymmdd') ,'yyyymmdd' )   --substr(FEEDATE,1,6),
      ,idno
      ,case 
              when FHID not in ('PS','CB','YB','SN') then '基金' 
              when TRIM(FHID) ='YB' then 'ETF'
              when FHID ='PS' then '海外股票'
              when FHID like 'TA%' or FHID  like 'TB%' or FHID  like 'TD%' or FHID  like 'TE%'  then '集合管理帳戶'
       end
       ,baopcccode;

  ;

      yyyymmdd ,

      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險

      yyyymmdd,

      yyyymmdd,

from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收

select

      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,

      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,

      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT

from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收

      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量

select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)

      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,

      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;     


drop table INCOME_TMP02;
Create table INCOME_TMP02
as 
select a.*,
       b.emp_no,
       b.prft_cntr_cd,
       b.sht_nm,
       case 
          when sht_nm like '%業務一部%' then 'TW一部'
          when sht_nm like '%業務二部%' then 'TW二部'
        end as SHT_EASY_NM,
      substr(
          sht_nm,
          instr(sht_nm,'業')+2,
          instr(sht_nm,'部') -instr(sht_nm,'業') -1
          )  as SHT_SUB_NM, 
       b.pst_nm
--count(*)
from INCOME_TMP01 a   --55772
left join PB_CUST_005 b  --55772
on a.cust_id =b.cust_id and substr(a.yyyymmdd,1,6)=b.yyyymm;

drop table INCOME_REPORT;
Create table INCOME_REPORT
as 
select 
       substr(yyyymmdd,1,4) yyyy,
       substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,
       yyyymmdd,
       typ,
       prod_type,
       sub_type,
       prft_cntr_cd,
       sht_nm,
       sht_easy_nm,
       '私人銀行'||sht_sub_nm as sht_sub_nm ,
       sum(amt) AMT,
       count(*) CNT
from INCOME_TMP02
where prft_cntr_cd is not null
group by 
       substr(yyyymmdd,1,4) ,
       substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) ,
       yyyymmdd,
       typ,
       prod_type,
       sub_type,
       prft_cntr_cd,
       sht_nm,
       sht_easy_nm,
       sht_sub_nm;
       
 EXIT;

create table AUM
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_022  --銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_025  ----25.證券_基金_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_027   --27.證券_台股_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_028   ----28.股票設質
;

create table AUM_TMP01
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_022  --銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_025  ----25.證券_基金_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_027   --27.證券_台股_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_028   ----28.股票設質
;

create table AUM_005_007_008_009
as
select  a.*,
        case when detail in ('台幣存款','外幣存款') then '台外幣存款' 
        else detail end as TYP_SUB_DTL
from AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP01 a 
union

        case when detail in ('台幣存款','外幣存款') then '台外幣存款' 
        else detail end as TYP_SUB_DTL
from AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP02 a

        else detail end as TYP_SUB_DTL

        case when detail in ('台幣存款','外幣存款') then '台外幣存款' 
        else detail end as TYP_SUB_DTL
from AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP05 a 
union
select  a.*,
        case when detail in ('台幣存款','外幣存款') then '台外幣存款' 
        else detail end as TYP_SUB_DTL
from AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP06 a 
union 
select  a.*,
        case when detail in ('台幣存款','外幣存款') then '台外幣存款' 
        else detail end as TYP_SUB_DTL
from AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP07 a 
union 
select  a.*,

        else detail end as TYP_SUB_DTL
from AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP08 a 
;

properties.sql:
create table AUM
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_022  --銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_025  ----25.證券_基金_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_027   --27.證券_台股_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_028   ----28.股票設質
;

create table AUM_TMP01
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_022  --銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_025  ----25.證券_基金_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_027   --27.證券_台股_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_028   ----28.股票設質
;

create table AUM_019
as 
select a.*
from AUM_019_TMP_01 a 
inner join 
(
  select substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm ,max(yyyymmdd) yyyymmdd 
  from AUM_019_TMP_01
  group by substr(yyyymmdd,1,6)

  (
  select   substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,max(yyyymmdd) yyyymmdd

  group by substr(yyyymmdd,1,6)
  ) b

create table AUM
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,

select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,

    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值

from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量

    '證券'  COMP,

properties.sql:
create table AUM_TMP01
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_022  --銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_025  ----25.證券_基金_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_027   --27.證券_台股_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_028   ----28.股票設質
;

create table AUM_021
as
select a.yyyymmdd,a.cust_id,a.AMT
from AUM_021_TMP01 a
inner join 
  (
  select   substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,max(yyyymmdd) yyyymmdd
  from AUM_021_TMP01
  group by substr(yyyymmdd,1,6)

;

properties.sql:
create table AUM_TMP01
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_022  --銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_025  ----25.證券_基金_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_027   --27.證券_台股_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_028   ----28.股票設質
;

properties.sql:
create table AUM
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_022  --銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_025  ----25.證券_基金_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_027   --27.證券_台股_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_028   ----28.股票設質
;

properties.sql:
create table AUM_TMP01
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_022  --銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_025  ----25.證券_基金_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_027   --27.證券_台股_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_028   ----28.股票設質
;

properties.sql:
create table ROA_TMP_01
as 
select a.*,b.amt as INCOME,
       c.AUM as AUM ,
       d.ln_amt 
from PB_CUST_TMP06 a  --客戶  28470
left join  ( select cust_id,substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,sum(amt) amt from INCOME_TMP02 group by cust_id,substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) ) b  --收入 28470
on a.yyyymm=b.yyyymm and a.cust_id=b.cust_id
left join (select substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,cust_id,sum(amt) AUM from AUM_TMP02 group by cust_id,substr(yyyymmdd,1,6)) c --AUM  --28470
on a.yyyymm=c.yyyymm and a.cust_id=c.cust_id
left join 
        ( 
         select yyyymm,cust_id,sum(ln_amt) ln_amt
         from 
         (
           SELECT yyyymm,cust_id,ln_bal ln_amt  FROM 台幣放款_私銀
           UNION 
           SELECT yyyymm,cust_id,bal_amt ln_amt  FROM 外幣放款_私銀
           UNION
           SELECT to_number(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1, 'YYYYMM')) YYYYMM,cust_id,ln_bal ln_amt  FROM 台幣放款_私銀CURRENT
           UNION 
           SELECT to_number(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1, 'YYYYMM')) YYYYMM, CUST_ID,bal_amt ln_amt FROM 外幣放款_私銀CURRENT
          ) a
         group by yyyymm,cust_id
          ) d
  on a.yyyymm=d.yyyymm and a.cust_id=d.cust_id;

create table INCOME_066_TMP02
as
     SELECT cust_id,yyyymmdd,sum(AMT) AMT
     FROM (
        SELECT cust_id,yyyymm || '01'  yyyymmdd, sum(GROSS_INCM)  AMT --TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, BAL_AMT, GROSS_INCM 利息 
        FROM DSDEP.DEP_NT_ACCT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01
        where TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) IN ('2E3000', '2E3200', '2E3300', '2E3400') AND YYYYMM>'202505' 
        group by cust_id,yyyymm
        UNION ALL
        SELECT cust_id, yyyymm || '01' yyyymmdd,sum(GROSS_INCM)  AMT --* --TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, AVAIL_BAL, GROSS_INCM 
        FROM DSDEP.DEP_FN_ACCT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01
        WHERE  TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) IN ('2E3000', '2E3200', '2E3300', '2E3400') AND YYYYMM>'202505'
        group by cust_id,yyyymm
        UNION ALL
        SELECT  cust_id, yyyymm || '01' yyyymmdd,sum(GROSS_INCM)  AMT-- TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, BAL_AMT, GROSS_INCM 
        FROM DSDEP.EMP_DEP_NT_ACCT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01
        WHERE  TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) IN ('2E3000', '2E3200', '2E3300', '2E3400') AND YYYYMM>'202505'
        group by cust_id,yyyymm
        ) 
GROUP BY cust_id,yyyymmdd;

properties.sql:
create table AUM_023_024_TMP0
as 
select idno as cust_id,prcs_dt as yyyymmdd,nm,sum(NETQTY/100 *CPRICE * exch_rt) AMT
from 
      (select a.*,
              case when  bond like 'TSSN%' then '複委託結構型商品'
              else '複委託債券' end as NM
      from  DSPBM.PB_BONDPOS_SEC_M@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a ) a
left join 
     ( select A.*
     from dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a
     inner join 
     ( 
         select substr(prcs_dt,1,6) yyyyymm,max(prcs_dt) prcs_dt 
         from dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01 
         group by substr(prcs_dt,1,6)
     ) b on a.prcs_dt=b.prcs_dt
     )b  on a.currency=b.curr_cd and a.yyyymm=substr(b.prcs_dt,1,6)
group by idno,prcs_dt,nm
;

from  (select *
      from  DSPBM.PB_STOCKPOS_SEC_M@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a ) a

     ( select A.*

     )b  on a.currency=b.curr_cd and a.yyyymm=substr(b.prcs_dt,1,6)
group by idno,b.prcs_dt
;

       when trustprd ='結構型商品' then '境外結構型商品'
    else trustprd end;

properties.sql:
create table INCOME_033_034_035_036
as 
select  to_char(to_date(feedate+19110000,'yyyymmdd') ,'yyyymmdd' ) as yyyymmdd --substr(FEEDATE,1,6)  -- FHID,IDNO as cust_id,      
        ,idno as cust_id       
        ,case 
              when FHID not in ('PS','CB','YB','SN') then '基金' 
              when TRIM(FHID) ='YB' then 'ETF'
              when FHID ='PS' then '海外股票'
              when FHID like 'TA%' or FHID  like 'TB%' or FHID  like 'TD%' or FHID  like 'TE%'  then '集合管理帳戶'
        end as   FH_TYP 
        ,baopcccode PCCODE

properties.sql:
create table INCOME_067_TMP02
as
select cust_id,yyyymmdd,sum(AMT) AMT
from 
(
    SELECT cust_id, yyyymm ||'01'  as yyyymmdd,sum(GROSS_INCM) AMT  -- ACC_CD, SUM(LN_BAL), SUM(GROSS_INCM) FROM (
    FROM DSLON.LN_NT_ACCT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01 A
    WHERE  PRFT_CNTR_CD IN ('2E3000', '2E3200', '2E3300', '2E3400')
    AND  YYYYMM>'202505'
    group by cust_id,yyyymm
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cust_id, yyyymm || '01' as yyyymmdd, sum(INT_INCM - CB_INT_AMT) AMT --ACC_CD, BAL_AMT, 
    FROM DSLON.LN_FN_ACCT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01 A
    WHERE TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) IN ('2E3000', '2E3200', '2E3300', '2E3400')
    AND YYYYMM>'202505'
    group by cust_id,yyyymm
)  a 
GROUP BY cust_id,yyyymmdd;

create table AUM_023_024_TMP1
as 
select  idno as cust_id,clrdate as yyyymmdd,nm,sum(NETQTY/100 *CPRICE * exch_rt) AMT
from 
(
 select a.*,b.*,
         case when  bond like 'TSSN%' then '複委託結構型商品'
       else '複委託債券' end as NM
from  DSPBM.PB_BONDPOS_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a 
left join  dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01  b 
on a.clrdate=b.prcs_dt and  a.currency=b.curr_cd
) a 
group by idno,clrdate,nm;

create table AUM_023_024_TMP0
as 
select idno as cust_id,prcs_dt as yyyymmdd,nm,sum(NETQTY/100 *CPRICE * exch_rt) AMT
from 
      (select a.*,
              case when  bond like 'TSSN%' then '複委託結構型商品'
              else '複委託債券' end as NM
      from  DSPBM.PB_BONDPOS_SEC_M@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a ) a
left join 
     ( select A.*
     from dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a
     inner join 
     ( 
         select substr(prcs_dt,1,6) yyyyymm,max(prcs_dt) prcs_dt 
         from dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01 
         group by substr(prcs_dt,1,6)
     ) b on a.prcs_dt=b.prcs_dt
     )b  on a.currency=b.curr_cd and a.yyyymm=substr(b.prcs_dt,1,6)
group by idno,prcs_dt,nm
;

;

create table INCOME_053_TMP01
as
select 'PM' AP ,idno as cust_id,
        CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
       END as yyyymmdd,
       sum((CFEE-ABFEE)*FXRATE) as amt
from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_PM_SEC_M@anadbp01_dwdbp01 t
LEFT JOIN T_LAST_TWO_WORKDAYS l ON SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6) = l.YM
group by idno,CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
       END
union
select  'AM' AP ,idno as cust_id,
         CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
         END as yyyymmdd,
        sum((CFEE-ABFEE)*FXRATE) as amt
from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_AM_SEC_M@anadbp01_dwdbp01 t
LEFT JOIN T_LAST_TWO_WORKDAYS l ON SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6) = l.YM
group by idno,CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
       END;

create table INCOME_053_TMP02
as
select 'PM' AP ,idno as cust_id,
        CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
       END as yyyymmdd,
       sum((CFEE-ABFEE)*FXRATE) as amt
from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_PM_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01 t
LEFT JOIN T_LAST_TWO_WORKDAYS l ON SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6) = l.YM
where yyyymmdd = (select max(yyyymmdd) from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_PM_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01)
group by idno,CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
       END
union
select  'AM' AP ,idno as cust_id,
        CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
         END as yyyymmdd,
        sum((CFEE-ABFEE)*FXRATE) as amt
from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_AM_SEC_M@anadbp01_dwdbp01 t
LEFT JOIN T_LAST_TWO_WORKDAYS l ON SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6) = l.YM
where yyyymmdd =(select max(yyyymmdd) from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_AM_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01)
group by idno,CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
         END;

Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;

Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;

Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;

Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;

Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;

Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;

Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;

Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;
