Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量

select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,

Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select

      dept_easy_nm as NM,

select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量

select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null

select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,

      yyyymmdd,

      yyyymmdd,

select

      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,

      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收

select

      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/

Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,

Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,

Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select

      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,

      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE,

      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT

Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT

union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收

select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select

      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,

      AMT

properties.sql:
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;

properties.sql:
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;

Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,

Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select

from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量

select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE,

      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量

select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,

      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,

from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益

select

select

select

select

      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/

      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',

      '手收'  as  TYP,

      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量

select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,

      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,

properties.sql:
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;

Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',

      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,

      yyyymmdd,

from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量

      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,

      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)

select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,

      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)

      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)

      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,

      yyyymmdd,

      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',

      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量

      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,

      AMT

      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;

Create table INCOME_TMP02
as 
select a.*,
       b.emp_no,
       b.prft_cntr_cd,
       b.sht_nm,
       case 
          when sht_nm like '%業務一部%' then 'TW一部'
          when sht_nm like '%業務二部%' then 'TW二部'
        end as SHT_EASY_NM,
      substr(
          sht_nm,
          instr(sht_nm,'業')+2,
          instr(sht_nm,'部') -instr(sht_nm,'業') -1
          )  as SHT_SUB_NM, 
       b.pst_nm
--count(*)
from INCOME_TMP01 a   --55772
left join PB_CUST_005 b  --55772
on a.cust_id =b.cust_id and substr(a.yyyymmdd,1,6)=b.yyyymm;

create table ROA_TMP_01
as 
select a.*,b.amt as INCOME,
       c.AUM as AUM ,
       d.ln_amt 
from PB_CUST_TMP06 a  --客戶  28470
left join  ( select cust_id,substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,sum(amt) amt from INCOME_TMP02 group by cust_id,substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) ) b  --收入 28470
on a.yyyymm=b.yyyymm and a.cust_id=b.cust_id
left join (select substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,cust_id,sum(amt) AUM from AUM_TMP02 group by cust_id,substr(yyyymmdd,1,6)) c --AUM  --28470
on a.yyyymm=c.yyyymm and a.cust_id=c.cust_id
left join 
        ( 
         select yyyymm,cust_id,sum(ln_amt) ln_amt
         from 
         (
           SELECT yyyymm,cust_id,ln_bal ln_amt  FROM 台幣放款_私銀
           UNION 
           SELECT yyyymm,cust_id,bal_amt ln_amt  FROM 外幣放款_私銀
           UNION
           SELECT to_number(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1, 'YYYYMM')) YYYYMM,cust_id,ln_bal ln_amt  FROM 台幣放款_私銀CURRENT
           UNION 
           SELECT to_number(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1, 'YYYYMM')) YYYYMM, CUST_ID,bal_amt ln_amt FROM 外幣放款_私銀CURRENT
          ) a
         group by yyyymm,cust_id
          ) d
  on a.yyyymm=d.yyyymm and a.cust_id=d.cust_id;

Create table INCOME_REPORT
as 
select 
       substr(yyyymmdd,1,4) yyyy,
       substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,
       yyyymmdd,
       typ,
       prod_type,
       sub_type,
       prft_cntr_cd,
       sht_nm,
       sht_easy_nm,
       '私人銀行'||sht_sub_nm as sht_sub_nm ,
       sum(amt) AMT,
       count(*) CNT
from INCOME_TMP02
where prft_cntr_cd is not null
group by 
       substr(yyyymmdd,1,4) ,
       substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) ,
       yyyymmdd,
       typ,
       prod_type,
       sub_type,
       prft_cntr_cd,
       sht_nm,
       sht_easy_nm,
       sht_sub_nm;

create table ROA_TMP_01
as 
select a.*,b.amt as INCOME,
       c.AUM as AUM ,
       d.ln_amt 
from PB_CUST_TMP06 a  --客戶  28470
left join  ( select cust_id,substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,sum(amt) amt from INCOME_TMP02 group by cust_id,substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) ) b  --收入 28470
on a.yyyymm=b.yyyymm and a.cust_id=b.cust_id
left join (select substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,cust_id,sum(amt) AUM from AUM_TMP02 group by cust_id,substr(yyyymmdd,1,6)) c --AUM  --28470
on a.yyyymm=c.yyyymm and a.cust_id=c.cust_id
left join 
        ( 
         select yyyymm,cust_id,sum(ln_amt) ln_amt
         from 
         (
           SELECT yyyymm,cust_id,ln_bal ln_amt  FROM 台幣放款_私銀
           UNION 
           SELECT yyyymm,cust_id,bal_amt ln_amt  FROM 外幣放款_私銀
           UNION
           SELECT to_number(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1, 'YYYYMM')) YYYYMM,cust_id,ln_bal ln_amt  FROM 台幣放款_私銀CURRENT
           UNION 
           SELECT to_number(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1, 'YYYYMM')) YYYYMM, CUST_ID,bal_amt ln_amt FROM 外幣放款_私銀CURRENT
          ) a
         group by yyyymm,cust_id
          ) d
  on a.yyyymm=d.yyyymm and a.cust_id=d.cust_id;

create table INCOME_053_TMP02
as
select 'PM' AP ,idno as cust_id,
        CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
       END as yyyymmdd,
       sum((CFEE-ABFEE)*FXRATE) as amt
from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_PM_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01 t
LEFT JOIN T_LAST_TWO_WORKDAYS l ON SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6) = l.YM
where yyyymmdd = (select max(yyyymmdd) from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_PM_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01)
group by idno,CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
       END
union
select  'AM' AP ,idno as cust_id,
        CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
         END as yyyymmdd,
        sum((CFEE-ABFEE)*FXRATE) as amt
from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_AM_SEC_M@anadbp01_dwdbp01 t
LEFT JOIN T_LAST_TWO_WORKDAYS l ON SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6) = l.YM
where yyyymmdd =(select max(yyyymmdd) from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_AM_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01)
group by idno,CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
         END;

create table ROA_TMP_01
as 
select a.*,b.amt as INCOME,
       c.AUM as AUM ,
       d.ln_amt 
from PB_CUST_TMP06 a  --客戶  28470
left join  ( select cust_id,substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,sum(amt) amt from INCOME_TMP02 group by cust_id,substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) ) b  --收入 28470
on a.yyyymm=b.yyyymm and a.cust_id=b.cust_id
left join (select substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,cust_id,sum(amt) AUM from AUM_TMP02 group by cust_id,substr(yyyymmdd,1,6)) c --AUM  --28470
on a.yyyymm=c.yyyymm and a.cust_id=c.cust_id
left join 
        ( 
         select yyyymm,cust_id,sum(ln_amt) ln_amt
         from 
         (
           SELECT yyyymm,cust_id,ln_bal ln_amt  FROM 台幣放款_私銀
           UNION 
           SELECT yyyymm,cust_id,bal_amt ln_amt  FROM 外幣放款_私銀
           UNION
           SELECT to_number(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1, 'YYYYMM')) YYYYMM,cust_id,ln_bal ln_amt  FROM 台幣放款_私銀CURRENT
           UNION 
           SELECT to_number(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1, 'YYYYMM')) YYYYMM, CUST_ID,bal_amt ln_amt FROM 外幣放款_私銀CURRENT
          ) a
         group by yyyymm,cust_id
          ) d
  on a.yyyymm=d.yyyymm and a.cust_id=d.cust_id;

create table ROA_TMP_01
as 
select a.*,b.amt as INCOME,
       c.AUM as AUM ,
       d.ln_amt 
from PB_CUST_TMP06 a  --客戶  28470
left join  ( select cust_id,substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,sum(amt) amt from INCOME_TMP02 group by cust_id,substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) ) b  --收入 28470
on a.yyyymm=b.yyyymm and a.cust_id=b.cust_id
left join (select substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,cust_id,sum(amt) AUM from AUM_TMP02 group by cust_id,substr(yyyymmdd,1,6)) c --AUM  --28470
on a.yyyymm=c.yyyymm and a.cust_id=c.cust_id
left join 
        ( 
         select yyyymm,cust_id,sum(ln_amt) ln_amt
         from 
         (
           SELECT yyyymm,cust_id,ln_bal ln_amt  FROM 台幣放款_私銀
           UNION 
           SELECT yyyymm,cust_id,bal_amt ln_amt  FROM 外幣放款_私銀
           UNION
           SELECT to_number(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1, 'YYYYMM')) YYYYMM,cust_id,ln_bal ln_amt  FROM 台幣放款_私銀CURRENT
           UNION 
           SELECT to_number(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1, 'YYYYMM')) YYYYMM, CUST_ID,bal_amt ln_amt FROM 外幣放款_私銀CURRENT
          ) a
         group by yyyymm,cust_id
          ) d
  on a.yyyymm=d.yyyymm and a.cust_id=d.cust_id;

create table ROA_TMP_01
as 
select a.*,b.amt as INCOME,
       c.AUM as AUM ,
       d.ln_amt 
from PB_CUST_TMP06 a  --客戶  28470
left join  ( select cust_id,substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,sum(amt) amt from INCOME_TMP02 group by cust_id,substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) ) b  --收入 28470
on a.yyyymm=b.yyyymm and a.cust_id=b.cust_id
left join (select substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,cust_id,sum(amt) AUM from AUM_TMP02 group by cust_id,substr(yyyymmdd,1,6)) c --AUM  --28470
on a.yyyymm=c.yyyymm and a.cust_id=c.cust_id
left join 
        ( 
         select yyyymm,cust_id,sum(ln_amt) ln_amt
         from 
         (
           SELECT yyyymm,cust_id,ln_bal ln_amt  FROM 台幣放款_私銀
           UNION 
           SELECT yyyymm,cust_id,bal_amt ln_amt  FROM 外幣放款_私銀
           UNION
           SELECT to_number(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1, 'YYYYMM')) YYYYMM,cust_id,ln_bal ln_amt  FROM 台幣放款_私銀CURRENT
           UNION 
           SELECT to_number(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1, 'YYYYMM')) YYYYMM, CUST_ID,bal_amt ln_amt FROM 外幣放款_私銀CURRENT
          ) a
         group by yyyymm,cust_id
          ) d
  on a.yyyymm=d.yyyymm and a.cust_id=d.cust_id;
